open_issues: Not derivable: which five of the seven heads rewritten on Thaw 16 sit at weight 8 and 10. rpg/slice/FIRST_REGION.md §7.3a and rpg/systems/ADVENTURE_ENGINE.md §4 both say 'five heads rewritten at 8 and 10' without naming them, and rows 19, 20 and 26 admit two readings of 'everyone who heard the promise' — one that puts Marrock and Reyne at 8, one at 6. Half is settled: row 20 marks no +2 on the contract's parties, so Marrock is at w6, which is what Gulla's w4 on Thaw 23 needs and is the reading rpg/systems/PROGRESSION_ECONOMY.md §5's fifty-hour renown floor took. The residue is worth 25 renown at hour fifty (about 5% of 505) and zero in the traced twenty hours, where the row's delta is 0 under every reading.

Ranged, not measured: the hour-ten purse, 'about 15 bits, ±10'. rpg/systems/PROGRESSION_ECONOMY.md §5 derives it from the trace, but two of its items — how many of the six road days and how much of the two marks of enemy purses fall before Thaw 21 — are printed by rpg/slice/FIRST_REGION.md §7.2 only as twenty-hour totals. It is under one mark either way, which is the whole of what the fairness row claims.

A floor, not a trace: region two's first ten hours priced at 175 renown inside rpg/systems/PROGRESSION_ECONOMY.md §5's hour-fifty model. It is priced at what the traced valley's own first ten hours were worth in a fresh valley (Thaw 21 14:00) and nothing in it is priced above what the trace measured, but region two has not been traced. The 505 it feeds is stated as a floor — it counts no head from region one's hours 20–40 — and the tier reading (Voice, floor 350) holds for any value of it above 20.
